note: 7-4 Earthmover lighting, emissives, and atmosphere pass (2026-11-21): crimson horizon directional rim light with controlled air scattering (7-4 has no active sun), calibrated emissive scaling on Back city windows (Cent_WindowLit) and hull/interior conduits (Cent_SmallLights), volumetric cleanup of the 4800 m desert killzone spot and 900 m head searchlight, Back city duplicate light dedup + blue searchlight shafts, Brain shop fix + hot-pink laser barrier area light + golden ceiling-grate shaft + cyan/magenta neon punch, Flesh interior cyan shaft & crimson depth.
